title: Step 9: Removing Extra Spaces for NLP Sentiment Analysis Text Cleaning

cues.en: -: Hello, and welcome to this art tutorial.
cues.zh: 講師：大家好，歡迎來到 R 教學。

cues.en: So that's it, we did the big first step of natural language processing, which consisted of cleaning the texts we're working with, and now, it's time to create the sparse matrix of features,
cues.zh: NLP 第一大步完成，清理文字，現在建立稀疏特徵矩陣，

cues.en: containing all the different reviews in the rows and all the different words of the reviews in the columns.
So as a reminder, what we're about to build is a huge table in which the row are the 1000 reviews.
cues.zh: 提醒，即將建立大表格，列是一千則評論。

cues.en: So we're gonna have one row for each review.
So we're gonna have 1000 rows, and then the columns are gonna contain all the words we can find in the 1000 reviews in this corpus that is the 1000 cleaned reviews.
cues.zh: 一千列，各欄包含 corpus 一千則乾淨評論中能找到的所有詞。

cues.en: And so basically what this means is that, we are gonna take all the different words in the 1000 cleans reviews in the corpus and we are gonna create one column for each word.
cues.zh: 基本上取所有不同詞，每詞建一欄。

cues.en: So suppose we count in total 1,500 words in this corpus of reviews.
Well, that means that our huge table is going to contain 1,500 columns.
And then for each sale in this huge table, well then each cell will correspond to one review corresponding to the row, and one word corresponding to the column.
cues.zh: 每格對應一列評論、一欄單詞。

cues.en: And so the value that will contain the cell is the number of times the word appears in the review.
cues.zh: 數值是該詞在該評論出現次數。

cues.en: So as we explained earlier, since most of the words don't appear in the reviews, well most of the cells will contain a zero.
cues.zh: 多數詞不在每則評論，所以多數格是 0。

cues.en: And then of course we'll get a few ones because each review is composed between five to 10 words.
cues.zh: 少數 1，因為每則五到十詞。

cues.en: So in each row we're gonna have five or 10 cells having a one, and all the other cells will have zero.
cues.zh: 所以每列五到十格是 1，其他 0。

cues.en: And the cells that have a one will be in the columns corresponding to the words that are in the review.
cues.zh: 1 在評論包含詞的對應欄。

cues.en: And maybe sometimes but very rarely, we'll get a two or a three.
That happens when the word appears twice or three times in a review.
I can give you a simple example.
Let's imagine that we have a super positive review saying, I love this restaurant very, very much.
cues.zh: 想像超正評：「I love this restaurant very, very much」。

cues.en: Well, in this review, the word very appears twice.
So for this particular review in the table that is, let's say it's the row a hundred, well in the cell that belongs to this row and that belongs to the column corresponding
cues.zh: 所以特定評論，假設第 100 列，與

cues.en: to the word very, well we'll get a two because very appears twice in this review.
cues.zh: very 欄交會格是 2，因為出現兩次。

cues.en: So that could happen, but it's very rare.
And what's most important to understand is that in this huge table we'll get mostly zeros, a few ones, and very few twos or threes, and we'll get so many zeros
cues.zh: 重要是大多 0、少數 1、極少 2 或 3，零多到

cues.en: that we call this table a sparse matrix.
A sparse matrix is a table that contains a lot of zeros.
It contains very few non-zero values and that's exactly what we're about to obtain because of what we've just explained.
cues.zh: 非零很少，剛解釋的情況正如此。

cues.en: And you'll see in the information of the table we build that we have the word sparsity.
cues.zh: 建立表格的資訊裡會看到 sparsity。

cues.en: And sparsity refers to that situation where we have a lot of zeros.
And speaking of sparsity, let's also keep in mind that, if we cleaned all the reviews here in this first step of national language processing it's in order to reduce as much as possible
cues.zh: 也記住，第一步清評論，是為了盡可能降低

cues.en: this future sparsity that will occur in this huge table that we're about to build.
cues.zh: 這張大表格未來的稀疏性。

cues.en: So that's the whole point behind this first step here, cleaning the text.
It's to avoid having too much sparsity.
That is, it's to avoid having a table too big with too many columns.
Because remember, one column is created for each word in the corpus.
So by doing all these steps here, we removed a lot of words and a lot of characters, punctuations numbers, et cetera, so that in this final huge table we get the minimum number
cues.zh: 這些步驟移除很多詞、字元、標點、數字，讓最後表格有最少

cues.en: of words and therefore the minimum number of columns.
And one last quick reminder, we are creating this table in order to have the framework of classification morals.
cues.zh: 最後提醒，建表格是為了分類架構。

cues.en: That is, you know, having several independent variables and one dependent variable.
cues.zh: 多個自變數、一個應變數。

cues.en: We haven't created the dependent variable yet.
It's actually in this data set here.
We will just take the second column of this data set because this contains the outcome whether the review is positive or negative.
cues.zh: 只取第二欄，含評論正負結果。

cues.en: We can see that here, it's the second column liked.
One of the review is positive and zero of the review is negative.
So that's the dependent variable column.
And the independent variables are going to be nothing else than these columns corresponding to each one of the words in the cleaned reviews of the corpus.
cues.zh: 自變數就是對應乾淨評論各詞的欄。

cues.en: Because for each review that is each observation we can link the review to each of the columns because for each of the review we can associate a value for each of the columns.
cues.zh: 每則、每筆觀測，都能和各欄連結，因為能為各欄指定數值。

cues.en: And this value is the number of times the word corresponding to the column appears in the review.
cues.zh: 就是欄對應詞在評論出現次數。

cues.en: So that's how we create our independent variables.
And then we'll create our dependent variable and therefore we'll get the classification model as we used to work with.
cues.zh: 再建應變數，就有熟悉的分類模型。

cues.en: And eventually we win because we will have everything.
We will have our independent variables, we will have our dependent variable and we already have all our classification models.
cues.zh: 有自變數、應變數，也已有全部分類模型。

cues.en: That's the models we made in part three.
So we will just need to apply these models on our new data set that we were about to create that contains the independent variables afterwards and the dependent variable
cues.zh: 只要套用到即將建立、含詞的自變數，以及原始資料集 Liked

cues.en: as the liked column in our original data set.
All right, so let's do it, let's create this table.
And in our, we can do it very efficiently using a function.
cues.zh: R 可以透過函式有效率完成。

cues.en: A function that is called document term matrix.
And it's super easy because this function will only take one argument.
cues.zh: 非常簡單，只要一個引數。

cues.en: And as you might have guessed it's going to be the corpus, and that's it, this will create this huge sparse matrix with all the 1000 reviews in the rows and with all the words of the reviews in the columns.
cues.zh: 猜得到是 corpus；就建立大稀疏矩陣，一千評論列，詞作欄。

cues.en: So let's do it.
Let's call this sparse matrix of features, DTM, because the function we're about to use is, document term matrix.
cues.zh: 矩陣叫 dtm，因為函式是 DocumentTermMatrix。

cues.en: So so far we'll call it DTM.
So equals, and then we use this super function document term matrix.
cues.zh: 等於，再使用這個強大函式。

cues.en: Here it is, I just need to press Enter.
And as I just said, we just need to input one argument, which is our corpus.
All right, and that's done, here it is, corpus.
This will create our sparse matrix of features.
So I'm going to select this line and execute, and done, the sparse matrix of features is created, it appears right here, DTM.
cues.zh: 選這行執行，完成，出現在這裡 dtm。

cues.en: We can click on this button here to have some info.
And actually what's interesting to see now is the total number of words counted in the corpus to create all the columns.
cues.zh: 現在有趣的是，為各欄計算的 corpus 總詞數。

cues.en: And we can see this total count here, 1,577.
So that means that the number of columns indicated by N column here in our document term matrix, our sparse matrix is 1,577.
cues.zh: 表示文件詞矩陣、稀疏矩陣的 ncol 欄數是 1,577。

cues.en: So that means that this huge table has 1000 rows.

So we expected this because of course we have 1000 reviews but we didn't expect the number of columns in total because simply that was the total number of words in the reviews, so we couldn't count them.
cues.zh: 預期如此，因為一千評論；但不知道總欄數，因為是所有不同詞，無法直接數。

cues.en: But we can see this number here, 1,577.
So that's already a big table.
But be prepared if you're working with more complicated text or longer text like articles or books, well, you might get a lot more columns here because you will get a lot more words.
cues.zh: 但若文字更複雜、更長，例如文章、書，詞更多，欄可能更多。

cues.en: So what you'll have to do, and you can ask me any questions about that in the Q&A, is reduce even more disparity by filtering the words in your text.
cues.zh: 所以需要進一步過濾詞、減少稀疏性，有問題可問答區問。

cues.en: And speaking of filtering, that's what we're gonna do right now.
We are going to apply a filter to clean even more the reviews by only considering the most frequent words.
cues.zh: 只考慮最常見詞，進一步清理。

cues.en: That means that it's like we're going to add a step in this text clean process, which will consist of only taking the words that are the most frequent.
cues.zh: 相當於清理增加一步，只取最頻繁詞。

cues.en: For example, the words that appear in only one review well, they might be removed, because they're not frequent.
cues.zh: 只在一則出現的可能移除，因為不常見。

cues.en: They only appear once.
Only one cell in the matrix race contains a one because this words only appear in one review.
cues.zh: 矩陣只有一格是 1，因為只一則包含。

cues.en: And these words, of course are not very relevant because since they only appear in one review, well, our machine learning classification model will not be able to establish any correlation
cues.zh: 當然不太有意義，模型無法從單則建立此詞

cues.en: between this word and the outcome whether the review is positive or negative.
Because indeed to understand such correlations the word would need to appear in at least two reviews.
cues.zh: 要理解關聯，至少兩則得出現。

cues.en: So that's the kind of words we're going to remove.
And again, this is in order to reduce sparsity.
And speaking of sparsity, I will show you something very interesting right now.
If we go to the console and type here DTM, then we'll get other information about this sparse matrix of features.
cues.zh: 主控台輸入 dtm，取得其他矩陣資訊。

cues.en: And the information that I want to highlight here is of course, this sparsity information.
And as you can see, the sparsity is a hundred percent right now, and that's because there are a lot of zeros in the matrix and also because we haven't filtered any non frequent word yet.
cues.zh: 目前 100%，因為很多零，尚未過濾不常見詞。

cues.en: So that's what we'll do right now.
We will filter all the words that appear only once.
We will filter all the words that are not frequent in the reviews.
All right, so let's do it.
To do this, we are going to update our document term matrix.
So we're taking, again, DTM here, because we're updating our sparse matrix and equals.
cues.zh: 再取 dtm，等於，因為更新。

cues.en: And now we're gonna use a function, a very practical function that will filter the non frequent words of our sparse matrix, which so far is nothing else than DTM.
cues.zh: 用實用函式，過濾目前 dtm 中不常見詞。

cues.en: So DTM will be one of the input.
And we will filter all the non frequent words by specifying a proportion of non frequent words that we want to remove from the sparse matrix.
cues.zh: 指定要移除的不常見詞比例，過濾它們。

cues.en: And this proportion of non frequent words will be obtained thanks to the second input of this function because the second input is the percentage of the most frequent words we want to keep in the reviews.
cues.zh: 透過第二輸入取得比例，因為它是想保留最常見詞的百分比。

cues.en: So let's say we want to keep 99% of the words in the review that are the most frequent words.
cues.zh: 假設保留 99% 最常見詞。

cues.en: Well, this second input will take the value of 99%.
So let's use this function.
This function is remove sparse terms.
Here it is, remove sparse terms.
So pressing Enter and ready to input the two arguments.
So the first argument is of course, the sparse matrix on which one to apply this filtering.
cues.zh: 第一是要套用過濾的稀疏矩陣。

cues.en: So of course it's DTM, all right?
And the second input is the proportion of words that are the most frequent words and that will be kept in this sparse matrix.
cues.zh: 第二是要保留的最常見詞比例。

cues.en: So let's say we want to keep 99% of the most frequent words.
Well, we would need to input here 0.99, and therefore we will build the same sparse matrix but this time containing 99% of the words
cues.zh: 輸入 0.99，建立相同矩陣，但這次含 99%

cues.en: that are the most frequent in this sparse matrix of features.
And therefore, you know, we're not looking at the corpus containing all the words and counting the most frequent words of this corpus.
cues.zh: 不是看 corpus 所有詞，再算其中最常見，

cues.en: What this function removes sparse terms will do, is to look at all the columns of this sparse matrix here and then keep 99% of the columns that have the most ones
cues.zh: removeSparseTerms 看矩陣所有欄，保留 99% 含最多 1

cues.en: in the columns because each column corresponds to a word.
And therefore, when there are very few ones in the columns that means that this word appears in very few reviews.
cues.zh: 欄很少 1，表示很少評論出現。

cues.en: And therefore these are the words that are non frequent in the reviews and accordingly not relevant.
cues.zh: 所以是不常見、因此無關詞。

cues.en: And that's why we can remove them.
All right, so let's do it.
Let's apply the filter.
To be cautious, let's maybe take a higher proportion of frequent words we keep, because actually with 99%, we might remove a lot of words.
cues.zh: 謹慎一點，也許保留更高比例，99% 可能移很多詞。

cues.en: You can try it on your RStudio to see.
But here, since we don't have many reviews, you know we have 1000 reviews that is not much compared to other texts we can work with in natural language processing.
cues.zh: 這裡只有一千評論，相對 NLP 其他文字不多。

cues.en: Let's be careful here and apply a nine to 9.9% proportion of frequent words.
cues.zh: 小心點，用 99.9% 常見詞比例。

cues.en: So here I'm gonna add a nine, and you'll see that it'll already remove quite a lot of words.
cues.zh: 再加一個 9，就會看到已移不少。

cues.en: So let's try it.
I'm going to select this and execute.
And indeed, as you can see, we now have 691 columns in the sparse metrics.
That is, we only kept 691 words.
So clearly we can see that by keeping 99.9% of the words that are the most frequent, well, that already removes almost 1000 words
cues.zh: 保留 99.9% 最常見詞，就已移除近一千詞，

cues.en: because originally we had remember, more than 1,500 words.
So be careful with this.
Be careful not to apply a too low proportion of frequent words you wanna keep.
And to choose that remember to look at the total number of words that is counted when you build this first sparse matrix.
cues.zh: 選擇時，記得看初建矩陣計算出的總詞數。

cues.en: And of course, you can also choose this number by conserving the total number of reviews you have in your original data set.
cues.zh: 也能考慮原始資料集評論總數。

cues.en: And you know, since we only had 1000 reviews, well, that's why we take such a high proportion here.
cues.zh: 只有一千則，所以取這麼高。

cues.en: And let's see by how much we reduce the sparsity.
So we have to type DTM again, because our document sparse matrix, that is our sparse matrix was just updated with all these words removed.
cues.zh: 再輸入 dtm，因為移除後矩陣剛更新。

cues.en: So pressing Enter here, and the sparsity now became 99%.
So better, but anyway, that was fine because we didn't have too much columns.
cues.zh: 更好，但本來欄不算太多，原先也可以。

cues.en: You will see that if you work with larger techs you will get a lot more words and therefore a lot more columns.
cues.zh: 文字更大，詞、欄都會更多。

cues.en: All right, so that will be all for this tutorial.
We built our bag of words model, congratulations for that.
And now it's time to make the classification model.
So that's what we'll do in the next and final tutorial of this section.
And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，祝你享受機器學習的樂趣。
